entries.title: Layers of Fear

emulation.notes: Use the native 2023 PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The 2023 Unreal Engine 5 release is the best route for the first Layers of Fear because it combines the original game, its Inheritance DLC, revised/additional narrative content, and the series-wide Writer framing in a higher-fidelity PC package.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Layers of Fear (2023) on Steam and play the Painter story and Inheritance content there. Use the 2016/Legacy versions only for historical comparison.

all_releases.reason: skip: superseded for fidelity and completeness by the 2023 Unreal Engine 5 version.
skip: lower-fidelity historical console routes with no sourced content advantage over the 2023 PC version.

all_releases.fidelity: Definitive Switch port of the original with Inheritance and Switch-specific control features.
all_releases.reason: skip: includes the original DLC and Switch features, but the 2023 PC release is higher fidelity and more complete overall.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC release with scalable settings and all-series compilation content.
all_releases.reason: primary: highest fidelity and most complete route for the first game's story.

all_releases.platform: macOS / PlayStation 5 / Xbox Series X|S (2023 remake)
all_releases.fidelity: Current-generation and macOS releases of the 2023 remake.
all_releases.reason: skip: same definitive content, but no sourced fidelity/capture advantage over Windows PC.
skip: portable/current Nintendo route, but no sourced fidelity or content advantage over Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The 2023 release changes and reframes the original game while adding/revising narrative content; choose it for fidelity and completeness, and use the 2016 original only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2023 version is a remake/series compilation, not a simple remaster. It combines the first game, DLC, sequel material, and new connective chapters in Unreal Engine 5.
